title: 地面比划下一步
description: 成人站在地面做小幅手脚动作模拟，不离地攀爬。

art_direction.medium: two-ink risograph with teal and coral spot colors and precise drawn anatomy
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult rehearses a modest climbing movement on the flat floor beside an empty low wall, one heel lifting slightly while one hand rises only to shoulder height. The other foot remains planted and there is no jumping or contact with holds. The adult looks toward a nearby short route with a thoughtful relaxed expression. Leave generous space around the figure and depict large hold shapes as a quiet background reference. Use a painterly oil-pastel illustration with broken strokes, strong volume, a dusty pink and petrol-blue palette, and inviting natural light. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels. Climbing stays low above continuous thick mats, with immediate step-down.
